svg.text: DESIGN YOUTUBE (DISTRIBUTED VIDEO STREAMING & TRANSCODING PLATFORM)
Resumable Chunked Uploads, Parallel GPU Transcoding DAG, Global CDN & Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) Playback
Direct-to-S3 Multipart Upload (Zero Backend Proxy Bottlenecks)
Origin Shield Cache Pull on Miss
Asynchronous DAG Transcoding & Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) Optimization
Video is sliced along keyframe (GOP) boundaries so 50+ GPU spot workers can encode chunks in parallel across AV1, VP9, and H.264.
Packaging into CMAF manifests enables seamless bitrate stepping (1080p → 720p → 480p) during network fluctuations with 0 rebuffering.
Playback: 5 Billion views/day (>98% CDN hit ratio)
SLA: P99 TTFF < 150ms via Anycast Edge CDN
2. Allocate S3 Multipart Part URLs & Upload ID
3. Return Presigned S3 URLs to Creator Client
4. Stream 10MB chunks directly to Raw S3 via PUT
5. Finalize Multipart Upload with part ETags
7. Split along keyframes & dispatch GOP chunks to GPU workers
8. Transcode to multi-bitrates & package HLS/DASH to Processed S3
9. Viewer requests playback → Edge CDN serves cached HLS segments (<150ms)
10. On edge cache miss, pull from Processed S3 Origin Shield
1. Direct-to-Storage Ingestion: Ingress API gateways never touch heavy media binary bytes; presigned S3 URLs offload gigabytes of network IO and eliminate reverse-proxy bottlenecks.
2. Chunk-Based Parallel DAG Encoding: Transcoding is parallelized across GOP boundaries onto spot GPU workers, reducing 1-hour 4K render times to under 3 minutes with fault isolation.
Core Principles: Presigned S3 Uploads + GOP DAG Transcoding + HLS/DASH ABR + Multi-CDN Edge Delivery
